compare.items: 5 harmful + 5 benign FIND requests x 4 new conditions (40 per model), greedy

reason: Refusals tie at 0. Fidelity: Qwen keeps meaning but its ne_cm mostly reverts to plain English (6/10) and its romanization is stilted (e.g. 'Copyr8t', 'sujanakha'); Gemma's romanization is natural WhatsApp style but about half its code-mixed drafts append 'yaani/basically' elaborations, 2 answer the request and 1 softens a harmful one. Gemma's failures are mechanically detectable (Devanagari leak, length > 1.6x source + 2 words) and go to the retry round and gate; Qwen's stilted spelling is not detectable. So Gemma plus a length guard and a one-line, same-length prompt instruction.

full_run.note: Items that still failed were rewritten outside the generator; they pass the same script, marker and length checks and were all reviewed by a native speaker.
